# Introduction

Line plot showing BMI change following successful treatment, colour coded by sex.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file  <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/05. Figure_5C"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter and recode

```{r}
process_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.numeric(Visit),
    BMI   = as.numeric(as.character(BMI)),
    Sex   = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  ) %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, BMI, Sex) %>%
  drop_na()

str(process_data)
```

Line plot
```{r}
#| label: line-plot
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6

line_plot <- ggplot(process_data, aes(x = Visit, y = BMI, group = ID1)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sex), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Female" = "magenta", "Male" = "blue")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 8),
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(12, 38, by = 2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI change following successful treatment",
    x     = "Visit (Week)",
    y     = "BMI",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 1, shape = 16))) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(line_plot)
```
Save plot
```{r}
#| label: save-output

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_main, "BMI change by sex.pdf"),
  plot     = line_plot,
  width    = 6.5,
  height   = 4.5
)

cat("Output saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
